description: This file defines the AWS ivschatClient class, which extends the AwsClient class to interact with the Amazon Interactive Video Service Chat API. It documents the available methods for managing chat tokens, logging configurations, rooms, users, tags, and events.
published: Aws	ext	ext	ext	ext	ext"ivschatClient

classes.name: ivschatClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Interactive Video Service Chat, providing methods for managing chat sessions, configurations, and related resources.

methods.name: createChatToken
methods.description: Creates a new chat token for a user in a chat room.

methods.name: createLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new logging configuration for the chat service.

methods.name: disconnectUser
methods.description: Disconnects a user from a chat room.

methods.name: getLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves details of a logging configuration.

methods.name: getRoom
methods.description: Retrieves details of a chat room.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a chat room.

methods.name: updateRoom
methods.description: Updates details of a chat room.
